brief:
Israeli airstrikes in Gaza escalated sharply following a meeting between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and international mediators Jared Kushner, Sergey Lavrov, and Tony Blair, Shehab Wire reported. The surge in bombing operations resulted in dozens of deaths and injuries across the territory, according to the report.

The three mediators had conveyed their positions during the encounter with Netanyahu. The intensified military campaign unfolded in the immediate aftermath of the talks, marking a significant uptick in the scale of Israeli operations in Gaza following the high-level diplomatic engagement.
